title: config/agents.yaml
description: The operator's harness/model map (plan 58, Phase 7). This is the shape bin/fleet/agents-config.sh, bin/fleet/dispatch-profile.sh, bin/model/local-model-lock.sh and bin/agents/einherjar-spawn.sh resolve at boot; a shape fault is refused loudly, naming the key and the file. Model and provider ids are NOT enumerated here — they are the operator's own and resolve from the hoard (Rule 07).

version.description: the config format version; the reader accepts 1

harness.description: the local/online rule: which harness owns a model by where it lives

providers.description: provider rename per harness, e.g. { llama.cpp: { pi: llama-cpp } }

default_model.description: the fallback model for any agent that does not name one

default_harness.description: the fallback harness when no local/online rule applies

local_concurrency.description: how many LOCAL models this machine may run at once (default 1)

providers.description: local, keyless model servers; `apply` writes these into the project harness config

agents.description: agent name -> model string, or { model, harness?, primary? }
